svg.text: Northfield WTP — Raw Water Transfer Pump Station · 415 V, 3 phase, 4 wire + earth, 50 Hz
Top entry, undrilled Al gland plate
Permissive + alarm — not a trip. Protects DOL feeders and catches reversed rotation after a supply change.
800 A BUSBAR — 3P + FULL-SIZE N + SEPARATE PE (Notes 1, 7)
1. PROSPECTIVE FAULT LEVEL IS AN ASSUMPTION: 25 kA for 1 s. Not confirmed. All device Icu/Ics and busbar Icw are PROVISIONAL. TQ-002 open.
2. Protection settings are NOT shown. No coordination study has been performed. Discrimination between Q1 and the feeder devices is UNVERIFIED. TQ-004 open.
3. Earthing shown as TN-S — ASSUMED, TQ-001. Separate N and PE bars. Instrument screen earth bar (not shown) is insulated and single-point bonded to the MEB.
4. Line reactors are provisional pending the harmonic assessment (TQ-006) and confirmation of actual motor cable route length against the drive manual limit.
5. VSD feeder breakers are selected from the DRIVE MANUAL, not from motor FLC. The breaker protects the cable and the drive input; the motor is protected by the
drive thermal model plus an independent PTC thermistor relay. Cable sizes are provisional — no AS/NZS 3008.1.1 calculation has been performed.
6. Assembly design verification (temperature rise, short-circuit withstand, IP) is the MANUFACTURER’S responsibility under AS/NZS 61439.1, not the designer’s.
7. Full-size neutral: TRIPLEN (3rd, 9th) harmonics are ZERO-SEQUENCE and ADD in the neutral instead of cancelling. Their source is the SINGLE-PHASE electronic load
(switch-mode supplies, UPS input, DB-01 lighting and GPOs) — NOT the six-pulse drives, which produce 6k±1 (5th, 7th, 11th, 13th). Those do not add in the neutral.
8. Rev 1 incorporates CR-001 — transfer pump motors uprated 75 kW to 90 kW following client hydraulic re-modelling. See NFD-ELE-CHG-0001.
RAW WATER TRANSFER PUMP STATION — MCC-01
SELF-DIRECTED REFERENCE PROJECT — NOT A PRODUCTION DRAWING
Illustrative only. Not for construction. Ratings provisional. See notes 1–7.
